'''Thuruht''' was a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive that imprisoned the powerful Force entity [[Abeloth]] on a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. When Abeloth broke free from her confinement in [[44 ABY]], the Thuruht prepared for the end of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The Thuruht had constructed the [[Centerpoint Station]] around [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]].
